hints.hi: Character ko result mein sirf tab add karo jab pehle nahi dekha gaya ho

# Remove duplicates, print result

approach.en: Use a seen set; add character to result only on first occurrence.
approach.hi: Seen set use karo; pehli occurrence pe hi character result mein add karo.

code.python:
s = input()
seen = set()
result = []
for c in s:
    if c not in seen:
        seen.add(c)
        result.append(c)
print(''.join(result))

explanation.hi: fl teeno mein common hai

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
strs = [input() for _ in range(n)]
# Find and print longest common prefix

approach.en: Start with first string as prefix; trim it until it matches the start of every string.
approach.hi: Pehli string ko prefix lo; tab tak trim karo jab tak har string ke start mein match na ho.

code.python:

problems.title: Longest Palindromic Substring

description.en: Given a string, find and print the longest substring that is a palindrome. If there are multiple with the same length, print the one that appears first.
description.hi: Ek string di gayi hai, sabse lamba palindromic substring dhundho aur print karo. Agar same length ke kai substrings hain, pehla aane wala print karo.

explanation.en: bab is a palindrome of length 3 (aba is also valid but bab comes first)
explanation.hi: bab length 3 ka palindrome hai (aba bhi valid hai par bab pehle aata hai)

explanation.en: bb is the longest palindromic substring
explanation.hi: bb sabse lamba palindromic substring hai

constraints: s contains only lowercase English letters

hints.en: Expand around each center: each character (odd length) and each pair (even length) can be a center
hints.hi: Har center ke around expand karo: har character (odd length) aur har pair (even length) center ho sakta hai

hints.en: Keep track of the longest palindrome found so far
hints.hi: Abhi tak ka sabse lamba palindrome track karo

starterCode.python:
s = input()
# Find and print the longest palindromic substring

approach.en: Expand around center for each index; check both odd and even length palindromes.
approach.hi: Har index ke liye center se expand karo; odd aur even length dono palindromes check karo.

code.python:
def expand(s, l, r):
    while l >= 0 and r < len(s) and s[l] == s[r]:
        l -= 1; r += 1
    return s[l+1:r]

s = input()
res = ''
for i in range(len(s)):
    odd = expand(s, i, i)
    even = expand(s, i, i+1)
    if len(odd) > len(res): res = odd
    if len(even) > len(res): res = even
print(res)

description.en:
Generate the nth term of the Count-and-Say sequence. The sequence starts with '1'. Each subsequent term is obtained by counting consecutive groups of same digits in the previous term.

Term 1: 1
Term 2: 11 (one 1)
Term 3: 21 (two 1s)
Term 4: 1211 (one 2, one 1)
description.hi:
Count-and-Say sequence ka nth term generate karo. Sequence '1' se start hoti hai. Har agla term pichle term mein consecutive same digits ke groups count karke banta hai.

Term 1: 1
Term 2: 11 (ek 1)
Term 3: 21 (do 1)
Term 4: 1211 (ek 2, ek 1)

explanation.hi: 4th term: 1211
5th term: ek 1, ek 2, do 1 = 111221

hints.en: Build each term from the previous by scanning consecutive runs
hints.hi: Har term pichle se banao consecutive runs scan karke

hints.en: Use a loop to count how many times a character repeats consecutively
hints.hi: Character kitni baar consecutively repeat hota hai count karne ke liye loop use karo

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
# Generate nth count-and-say term and print

approach.en: Iteratively build each term from previous by scanning runs of same characters.
approach.hi: Previous term se consecutive same characters ke runs scan karke iteratively har term banao.

code.python:
n = int(input())
cur = '1'
for _ in range(n - 1):
    nxt, i = '', 0
    while i < len(cur):
        c, cnt = cur[i], 0
        while i < len(cur) and cur[i] == c:
            cnt += 1; i += 1
        nxt += str(cnt) + c
    cur = nxt
print(cur)

problems.title: Minimum Window Substring

description.en: Given two strings s and t on separate lines, find the minimum window substring of s that contains all characters of t (including duplicates). If no such window exists, print an empty string.
description.hi: Do strings s aur t alag lines pe di gayi hain, s ka sabse chhota window substring dhundho jisme t ke sab characters ho (duplicates including). Agar aisa koi window nahi hai, khali string print karo.

explanation.en: BANC is the minimum window containing A, B, C
explanation.hi: BANC sabse chhota window hai jo A, B, C contain karta hai
Ek hi character match karta hai

constraints: s and t consist of uppercase and lowercase English letters

hints.en: Use sliding window with two pointers and a frequency map for t
hints.hi: t ke liye frequency map ke saath two pointers aur sliding window use karo

hints.en: Expand right pointer until all chars covered, then shrink left pointer
hints.hi: Jab tak sab chars covered na ho right pointer expand karo, phir left pointer shrink karo

starterCode.python:
s = input()
t = input()
# Find and print minimum window substring

approach.en: Sliding window: expand right to cover all of t, then shrink left while still valid, tracking minimum.
approach.hi: Sliding window: t ke sab chars cover karne ke liye right expand karo, phir valid rehte hue left shrink karo, minimum track karo.

code.python:
from collections import Counter
s = input()
t = input()
need = Counter(t)
have = {}
formed = required = len(need)
l = 0
min_len = float('inf')
min_l = 0
for r, c in enumerate(s):
    have[c] = have.get(c, 0) + 1
    if c in need and have[c] == need[c]:
        formed -= 1
    while formed == 0:
        if r - l + 1 < min_len:
            min_len = r - l + 1; min_l = l
        lc = s[l]; have[lc] -= 1
        if lc in need and have[lc] < need[lc]:
            formed += 1
        l += 1
print('' if min_len == float('inf') else s[min_l:min_l+min_len])
